product_metadata.title: Dporticus Double Rods Adjustable Clothing Garment Rack with 2 Tier Shoe Racks, Strainless Steel Storage Organizer, Coat Hanger with Wheels
features: AMPLE STORAGE SPACE：2 tiers and 2 side wings provide plenty storage space to organize clothes, shoes and take away the clutter.
COMFORTABLE TO USE: Distance between two vertical rods was widened to keep your standard clothes hangers straight without interfering and overlapping for your convenience.
HEIGHT & WIDTH ADJUSTABLE: Height and width of each rail can be adjusted separately to meet your extra storage needs for long shirt, lady dresses and pants; maximum Height: 61” (155cm).
STURDY & DURABLE: Made of high quality stainless steel clad pipes, premium ABS & PP plastic parts; holds up to 50 lbs and contributes long service time.
EASY MOVE & SETUP: Gently move with 4 agile wheels. Easy assembly, no tools required.
description: Description: This double row coat rack design is simple, save your interior space effectively.  The height and length can be adjusted according to the actual need：31.5-61inch.  Two shelf provide more space to storage your shoes, make you home well tidy and organized.  Design of the bottom wheel, easy to move, one-click brake.  The two ends of the Plug, Wind-proof, anti-fall, outdoor drying clothes more safe. Specification:  Material: stainless steel, ABS&PP plastic  Color: Silver & black  Height adjustable: 31.5"- 61"  Top bar length: 60.4”  Clothes rack width:16.5”  Weight: 7.3 lbs  Weight capacity: 50 lbs NOTE:  Works well for light clothing,it is not recommended to hang heavy items such as long winter coats .  All metal tubing must be securely inserted into the plastic legs and connectors to ensure proper assembly.  This clothing rack is not suitable for rolling on carpet.  Do not hang separately at either end, which can easily cause the rod to bend and break.  Be careful in the installation process, maybe you can wear a glove when install it.
